Explore solutions to key SharePoint deployment queries for your business. What is SharePoint deployment? SharePoint deployment refers to the practice of installing and configuring SharePoint to provide support to your organizations communication, collaboration, and document management requirements. Professional SharePoint deployment services offer a systematic platform to businesses, which further improves productivity and provides secure information sharing. How long does the SharePoint deployment process take? The SharePoint deployment process can take a long or short time depending on the scope of the project, level of customization, and integration involved. A rudimentary configuration can be installed in 3 to 5 weeks, but a complete bespoke-amped enterprise implementation will take 8 to 12 weeks (or more). Can SharePoint deployments integrate with other business tools? Yes. The SharePoint deployments blend well with Microsoft 365 apps such as Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and Power BI. Moreover, it may integrate with third-parties, including Salesforce, ServiceNOW, Slack, and ERP or HR administration systems. What are the benefits of SharePoint deployment services? It has key advantages: Centralized and safe information management Better inter-departmental communication Process flawlessness and automation of flow Remote and Hybrid team scalable collaboration tools A compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements What features are included in a SharePoint deployment? A SharePoint implementation usually consists of: Team and department sites Version controlled document libraries News and announcements center. Tools of project and task management Workflows and Automation Role-based permissions Mobile accessibility Third-party app and Microsoft 365 integrations How much do SharePoint deployment services cost? SharePoint deployment services cost varies based on complexity, features and scale. A simple installation can be priced between $7,000 and 15,000, whereas an enterprise-scale with features such as custom development and integrations may cost 25,000 to 100,000$ or more. If you have any questions about SharePoint deployment or need more information, don’t hesitate to reach out.
